feature_title: RUM Session Replay — gated Play button and no-replay empty state

rationale.edition: All 26 changed paths (from changed_files.txt) live under web/src/** and scripts/translations/**. None are enterprise-owned (no enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, or src/enterprise/ paths), and none of the enterprise keywords (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/sensitive-data/logo-management) appear in the paths or symbols. RUM/Session Replay is an open-source feature, so edition is oss.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. The change alters user-facing UI in two Vue components (TraceDetails.vue and SessionViewer.vue), and there is no tests-added label or skip request in the trigger comment. No skip markers present.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The 'Play Session Replay' button in TraceDetails is now gated on a rum_session_has_replay flag (previously shown for any span carrying a RUM session id), and SessionViewer gains a new 'No replay was recorded for this session' empty state. Both are user-exercisable UI flows that need verification.
rationale.area: Traces is the closest fit. The primary entry point is the traces TraceDetails view (web/src/plugins/traces/), the existing Traces test folder already holds traceDetails.spec.js, and there is no dedicated RUM test folder to map the web/src/views/RUM changes to.
rationale.group: The existing 'Traces' matrix shard in tests/ui-testing/ci-matrix already runs traceDetails.spec.js and trace-related specs; the new session-replay spec belongs in that same shard.
rationale.existing_tests: no E2E specs in the diff — the changed .spec.ts files are Vitest unit tests under web/src/**/*.spec.ts, not Playwright E2E specs under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/, so they do not count as existing E2E coverage.
